data.spec: Extend worker configuration and prompt construction so an agent run can receive explicitly selected skills or deterministic task-matched skills from the catalog, independent of planner/implementer/reviewer role names. Record selected skill IDs and versions for reproducibility, preserve existing runs when no skills are configured, and add end-to-end tests demonstrating discovery, prompt composition, invalid-skill handling, and one workflow from each seeded domain.
data.title: Integrate skill selection and composition into agent runs
